summary: Comprehensive documentation refresh plan for EatFitAI project. Categorizes all 35+ documentation files into Keep/Rewrite/Archive/Delete tiers. Proposes a new 7-doc production structure replacing the current 12-file numbered system. Includes detailed analysis of each existing doc's status (current vs stale), specific rewrite instructions, and a phased execution plan. Key decisions needed: whether to merge investigation docs, keep Vietnamese-only or add English headers, and archive threshold date.
